description: This file defines classes and methods for managing RAID configurations within a kickstart installation system, including support for multiple RAID levels and encryption options.

classes.name: FC3_RaidData
classes.description: Represents RAID data configuration for FC3 level, supporting RAID levels, device, filesystem type, and other options.

classes.name: FC4_RaidData
classes.description: Extends FC3_RaidData with filesystem options.

classes.name: FC5_RaidData
classes.description: Extends FC4_RaidData with bytes per inode option.

classes.name: RHEL5_RaidData
classes.description: Extends FC5_RaidData with encryption support and passphrase.

classes.name: F7_RaidData
classes.description: Inherits FC5_RaidData without additional modifications.

classes.name: F9_RaidData
classes.description: Extends F7_RaidData with filesystem profile, encryption, and passphrase.

classes.name: F12_RaidData

classes.name: F13_RaidData
classes.description: Inherits F12_RaidData without modifications.

classes.name: RHEL7_RaidData

classes.name: F29_RaidData

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes RAID data classes with provided parameters.

methods.name: _getArgsAsStr
methods.description: Generates string of command-line arguments based on RAID data attributes.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates argument parser for RAID command options.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into RAID data objects.

methods.name: dataList
methods.description: Returns the list of RAID data objects.

methods.description: Returns the class used for RAID data objects.
